actions.action: Bottom-soak pot in sink or bucket for 30-60 minutes, then drain completely
If still limp, slide plant out and check roots
If roots are mushy, trim rot and repot in fresh well-draining mix
If soil is packed and hard, repot into fresh mix
Trim fully brown/yellow leaves and spent spathes
Check soil and water when top few centimeters are dry
Move to indirect light away from heaters and drafts
Mist or raise humidity if air is dry

reason: The answer correctly identifies an underwatered peace lily and leads with a thorough soak, which matches the fix; its root checks are conditional and nothing in it is harmful.
